description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_유역별 빈도별 도시침수 지도 침수심 통계 조회 서비스 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 환경부 한강홍수통제소에서 제공하는 홍수위험지도 중 도시침수 지도를 기반으로 장마철 갑작스럽게 내리는 국지적 집중호우·돌발호우 등으로 유발되는 도시침수 결과의 5단계로 이루어진 침수심별. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 홍수, 침수, 범람, 도시, 침수심. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
